description.value:
As a bonus action, you can spend one minute in a meditative stance, letting the Force guide your aim. While in the stance, once each turn you add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum +1) to one ranged weapon attack and damage roll. In addition, making a ranged weapon attack while within 5 feet of a hostile creature no longer gives you disadvantage on the roll.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
